entry.title: An object that rolls just a little
entry.summary: Once a baby starts slithering, the authors describe a ball or rattle that rolls slowly and stays within a manageable distance, with mouthing-safe materials and secure parts.
entry.cue: Your baby is interested in moving toward something and trying to retrieve it.
detail: The book later describes baskets of balls with different textures and weights. A ball can be held and turned as well as followed; the baby’s chosen exploration matters.

The authors keep the challenge close enough to invite effort without discouraging frustration. Their appendix uses different age labels for different objects, including a creeping-readiness condition for the basket of balls.
